title: IterIS: Iterative Inference-Solving Alignment for LoRA Merging

layout.note: Three grey rounded panels side by side with bold lettered captions underneath. A small grey strip with the merge schematic sits above panel (a), outside its frame. Panel (a) splits left and right by a dashed vertical line, panels (b) and (c) split top and bottom by a dashed horizontal line, so the single LoRAs come first and the merged adapter last.

lesson: To show that a method is general, repeat one small motif (two specialised modules, then their merged result) in one panel per modality, keep one colour per source on every label, prompt token and caption tag, and add a tiny version of the motif with the method name as a key.
